technical.title: LO-World unifies 4D occupancy and LiDAR forecasting in a shared BEV latent space
technical.summary: LO-World is a unified 4D world model that forecasts both LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy within a shared BEV latent space, enabling dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other.
technical.why: It eliminates multi-pipeline redundancy for autonomous driving perception and world modeling.

technical.title: GEMOR-GS refines 3D Gaussian splatting SLAM mapping and relocalization
technical.summary: GEMOR-GS is a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM system that refines global extrinsic calibration and provides online relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting maps, delivering geometrically accurate and photorealistic scene representations.
technical.why: It improves scene geometry and appearance for continuous robot perception and decision-making.

technical.title: URL-Sim unifies and regulates LiDAR simulation for dynamic driving scenes
technical.summary: URL-Sim uses 3D Gaussian splatting to reconstruct high-fidelity LiDAR simulation scenes from real-world driving logs, addressing the slow rendering speeds of NeRFs and the unconstrained primitive densification of prior methods.
technical.why: It enables cost-effective safety validation and data generation for autonomous driving.

technical.title: RaMOD detects moving objects from raw mmWave radar cubes
technical.summary: RaMOD is a real-time framework for moving-object detection and velocity estimation using raw range-azimuth-Doppler cubes from a vehicle-mounted single-chip radar, overcoming ego motion and Doppler wrapping challenges.
technical.why: It unlocks weather-robust moving-object perception from raw automotive radar data.

technical.title: GTAGym evaluates agent perception and reinforcement learning in GTA V
technical.summary: GTAGym introduces an environment and benchmark derived from GTA V main-story missions, featuring 103 online tasks across nine task families and 47 image-based shooting tasks to evaluate agent perception, reasoning, and control.
technical.why: This provides a rich testbed for testing computer vision and reinforcement learning agents in complex virtual environments.

technical.title: Embodied First Exam evaluates coding agents controlling diverse robots
technical.summary: The Embodied First Exam is a comprehensive, agent-native evaluation framework featuring 1,156 tasks across 35 suites on 47 robots, allowing coding agents to choose direct control, code generation, or policy training.
technical.why: It tests whether coding agents can reliably control robotic systems under physical-world constraints.

technical.title: Maze Runner provides open autonomous stack for maze navigation
technical.summary: Maze Runner is an open autonomy stack in C++ and ROS 2 using 2D LiDAR, RANSAC wall line extraction, and Extended Kalman Filters for localization and mapping to navigate simulated mazes safely.
technical.why: It offers a practical reference implementation for autonomous robot localization, mapping, and control.

technical.title: MBZUAI releases PAN 2 open 29B world model for physical AI
technical.summary: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models released PAN 2, an Apache 2.0 world model coupling an LLM planner with a 29B diffusion transformer to simulate up to 20 seconds of action outcomes as video.
technical.why: It offers an open-weights model for physical AI simulation and planning tasks.

technical.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general robotic dexterity
technical.summary: This vision-language-action model update enhances robot dexterity, reliability, and safety for real-world operations.
technical.why: It represents a core model upgrade for embodied AI and physical manipulation systems.

technical.title: VIGOR benchmark evaluates visual rationale correctness in MLLMs
technical.summary: VIGOR evaluates visually grounded rationales in multimodal large language models using an automatic annotation framework that pairs explicit concepts with pixel-level groundings across multiple abstraction levels.
technical.why: It helps assess whether MLLMs base their conclusions on correct visual evidence.

business.title: Anthropic Seeks Record $88.5B in Public Market Debut
business.summary: Anthropic submitted an updated S-1 filing seeking up to $88.5 billion through an upcoming IPO and concurrent private placement.
business.why: This marks a massive capital injection into foundational AI model development and market scaling.

business.title: Nvidia Board Prepares to Dismiss CEO Jensen Huang
business.summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following reports of extramarital affairs.
business.why: Leadership stability at Nvidia carries profound implications for the entire AI hardware and industry landscape.

business.title: Paper Unicorns Are Cheap. Building A $1B Revenue AI Company Takes A Multimarket Cap Table

business.title: AI Data Center Boom Faces Severe Real-World Obstacles
business.summary: The data center boom faces local opposition, permitting delays, and electricity shortages, with many announced infrastructure projects potentially never being built.
business.why: Infrastructure bottlenecks directly impact the scaling and deployment capabilities of heavy AI workloads.

business.title: How backlash and red tape continue to slow data centers post-Blue Wave

business.title: Megaspeed Linked to U.S. Probe Over Restricted Chips
business.summary: Nvidia partner Megaspeed is facing a U.S. probe regarding its role in shipping billions of restricted Nvidia chips to China.
business.why: Supply chain restrictions and geopolitical probes directly impact hardware availability for AI engineering.

business.title: Exclusive: Nubank Alum Raises $14M For Colombia’s Palomma To Tackle Rent Payments, Landlord Financing
business.summary: Colombia-based startup, Palomma, has raised $10 million in Series A funding led by Mexican venture firm Cometa to expand its financial services business for landlords, tenants and property managers, Crunchbase News has e

business.title: TSMC to Invest $1B in Anthropic and OpenAI
business.summary: Semiconductor giant TSMC is investing $1 billion across Anthropic and OpenAI amid wobbling AI trade conditions.
business.why: Circular financing between chipmakers and frontier labs binds semiconductor manufacturing tightly to AI market growth.

business.title: Oura to Acquire Counsel Health for $625M
business.summary: Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million, following its decision to postpone an up to $2.2 billion IPO due to market uncertainty.
business.why: It highlights consolidation and strategic shifts within the health tech and AI hardware ecosystem.

models.title: Idol turns a single image into a 3D Gaussian splat
models.summary: Idol takes a single picture of an object and generates up to 1,048,576 3D Gaussians written as a standard 3DGS .ply, including unseen sides. It runs on consumer GPUs in under 2 seconds.
models.why: It enables rapid single-image 3D Gaussian splat generation directly on consumer hardware.

models.title: Ripple-65B Preview dense Transformer model launched with 1Mi context
models.summary: Ripple-65B Preview is a 65B parameter dense Transformer pretrained on 12 trillion tokens supporting up to 1Mi context. It scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, outperforming several much larger models.
models.why: It delivers high-end agentic coding performance in a dense 65B architecture with massive context length.

models.title: MiniMax-H3-Image open-source model launched for image generation and editing
models.summary: MiniMax-H3-Image is an open-source model for image generation and editing from the MiniMax H3 family, combining intelligent understanding of creative intent with precise instruction following.
models.why: It gives you a state-of-the-art open-source option for visual generation and editing tasks.

models.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro natively multimodal agentic model released with 1M context
models.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal 2.8T MoE model with 104B activated parameters and a 1-million-token context window, delivering improvements in coding, 3D creation, and research.
models.why: It offers an advanced open-weight multimodal agent model with a massive context window for complex tasks.

models.title: Qwen3.8-27B model weights and configuration files released
models.summary: Official model weights and configuration files for Qwen3.8-27B are now available in the Hugging Face Transformers format, compatible with frameworks like vLLM and SGLang.
models.why: It supplies the foundational base weights for deploying the Qwen3.8-27B model locally or via inference engines.

models.title: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder experimental small language model released
models.summary: This is an independent early preview fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B focusing on general coding and creating interactive 3D scenes with Three.js using small language models.
models.why: It explores the capabilities of lightweight models for specialized 3D scene generation and coding.
